preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of days N for each test case must be between 1 and 100000.
The number of places K must be between 2 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A[i] <= K or A[i] == -1 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each element in the sequence A must be either a valid place number between 1 and K or -1.
The total number of days across all test cases must not exceed 1,000,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if any(A[i] == -1 for i in range(N)) else stdout == 'YES'
postconditions.description: If there are any undecided days (-1) in the plan, the output must be 'YES' if a valid plan can be completed.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' if any(A[i] == A[i+1] for i in range(N-1)) else stdout == 'YES'
postconditions.description: If any two consecutive days have the same place, the output must be 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' and all(1 <= A[i] <= K for i in range(N))
postconditions.description: If the plan is completed, all elements in the sequence A must be valid place numbers between 1 and K.
